main_body: T-shaped timber prop with horizontal crossbeam and vertical support pillar
top_band: warm tan horizontal beam top from row 10 to 12 (with dark outline on row 9 and cream front-edge highlight on row 13)
evidence: Reading down the middle column: row 9 is the back outline, rows 10-12 form a warm tan top surface of the crossbeam, row 13 is a distinct bright cream front-edge highlight line (total 4 top rows), rows 14-16 are the darker brown front face of the crossbeam with row 17 as bottom outline, and rows 18-47 form the vertical support post set back under the overhanging crossbeam with an eave shadow on rows 18-19.

style.evidence: The wood material uses a 6-step ramp (cream highlight, light tan, mid-light tan, mid brown, dark brown, deep brown outline). Outlines are dark brown tinted to match the wood rather than pure black. Both the horizontal beam and vertical post feature wood grain dots, knots, and joinery banding without flat fills.
